## Email deliverability

### 1. Overview

- **Title (49/80):** I will set up SPF, DKIM and DMARC for your domain
- **Category:** Programming & Tech
- **Subcategory:** Support & IT
- **Service type:** Email Management (or the closest email / DNS option)
- **Gig metadata:**
  - Platform: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Mail (plus Other if offered)
  - Task: Setup / configuration, Troubleshooting
  - Leave unticked: migration, server administration, hosting, security audits
- **Search tags (5):** spf (3) · dkim (4) · dmarc (5) · email deliverability (20) · dns records (11)

### 2. Pricing

| | Basic | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | Check and records | Set up for you | Fix and clean up |
| Description | I check your domain and write the exact SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, with a paste guide. (88/100) | I add SPF, DKIM and DMARC for you, switch DKIM on, and send a test with a pass report. (86/100) | Standard, plus broken or duplicate records fixed for up to 3 senders, and a check a week later. (95/100) |
| Delivery | 1 day | 2 days | 3 days |
| Revisions | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Price | $40 | $75 | $125 |

**Extras:** Extra-fast delivery +$25 · Extra domain +$35

### 3. Description and FAQ

**Description (527/1200):**

```
Emails landing in spam? Your domain is often missing the records that prove your mail is really from you.

I set up the three that matter:
- SPF: who may send as you
- DKIM: signs each email so it can't be faked
- DMARC: what inboxes do with mail that fails

No passwords needed. You paste the records in while I guide you, or add me as a helper on your domain settings and remove me after.

Works with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Mailchimp, Square and most CRMs. Every order ends with a test send and a pass report.
```

- **Do you need my email password?** No. These records live in your domain settings. You can paste them in yourself, or give me helper access to the domain settings only and remove it after.
- **Will this guarantee my emails reach the inbox?** Nobody can honestly promise that. These records remove the most common reason mail is refused or marked as spam, and the report shows they pass.
- **I don't know where my domain is managed.** That's normal. Send me the domain name and I'll find out and tell you where to log in.
- **Do you use AI?** I use AI tools to draft and double-check. I do the setup and the testing myself.

### 4. Requirements (questions for the buyer)

1. Your domain name (the part after @ in your email).
2. Where your domain is managed, if you know (GoDaddy, Cloudflare...). If not, I will look it up.
3. Your email provider (Google, Microsoft, Zoho...).
4. Any other service that sends email as you: newsletters, invoices, your CRM, your website form.
5. If mail is going to spam now: one example (who it went to and roughly when).

- Company name and type
- Website, and whether it works
- Business phone and business email, where public
- City and year formed
